title: Named crew catalog
description: Top-level catalog of saved staffing blocks (named crews). A named crew records a supervisor route, worker routes per role, a reviewer route, an ordered escalation ladder, an authority value, and an evidence reference. Route references are opaque catalog ids resolved against the route catalog; this schema defines shape only and encodes no selection, ranking, probability, class metadata, or model preference. The authority value `policy` is reserved for the computed `auto` placeholder saved block and means the staffing system's choice.

crews.description: Saved staffing blocks. Each crew has a stable crew_id; crew_id `auto` is the single reserved placeholder id and pairs only with authority `policy`.

routeRef.description: Opaque reference to a route_id in the route catalog. Shape only: never resolved or interpreted here.

roleKey.description: Role name keying a worker route binding.

crew_id.description: Stable identifier for this saved staffing block. The reserved id `auto` marks the computed placeholder block and requires authority `policy`.

supervisor_route.description: Opaque route catalog id used for the supervisor role.

worker_routes.description: Worker routes keyed by role. Each role binds exactly one nonempty, duplicate-free, order-significant list of opaque route references; the list order is the role's route preference order. A single route must still be encoded as a one-element array.

reviewer_route.description: Opaque route catalog id used for the reviewer role.

escalation_ladder.description: Ordered, nonempty escalation ladder of opaque route catalog ids. Array order is the ladder order.

authority.description: Who set this block: `lee` pins or overrides; `chief` chooses under delegated managerial authority; `policy` is reserved for the computed `auto` placeholder and means the staffing system's choice.

evidence_ref.description: Nonempty reference to the evidence backing this saved block.

allOf.description: Authority `policy` is reserved for the computed placeholder block: it requires crew_id `auto`.

crew_id `auto` is the placeholder block: it requires authority `policy`, so a named crew (authority `lee` or `chief`) can never use the `auto` id and the placeholder can never carry `lee` or `chief` authority.
